WITH date_dim_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
customer_base AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name
    FROM customer
),
web_hits AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim_filtered d
    JOIN web_sales ws ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN customer_base c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_hits AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim_filtered d
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN customer_base c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
store_hits AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim_filtered d
    JOIN store_sales ss ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN customer_base c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_hits
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_hits
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_hits
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
